name: @orca/desktop
description: Orca desktop app — system tray + embedded server + dashboard
author: Orca contributors

scripts.build: yarn workspace @orca/app build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:mac: yarn workspace @orca/app build && electron-builder build --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:win: yarn workspace @orca/app build && electron-builder build --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:linux: yarn workspace @orca/app build && electron-builder build --linux --config electron-builder.config.cjs
